items.title: Be strong.
items.alt: Wen in a blue hero suit with a cape flies over a sunny city, caption: Be strong
items.note: Wen says: be strong. Stay strong, fren, and fly anyway.

items.title: Share your light.
items.sub: Good energy grows when you give it.
items.alt: Wen with glowing butterfly wings hovers over a city park, caption: Share your light
items.note: Wen says: share your light. Good energy grows when you give it.

items.title: Respect your elders.
items.alt: Wen in a white space suit greets smiling families and children in a city square, caption: Respect your elders
items.note: Wen says: respect your elders. Listen first, learn always.

items.title: Tell the truth.
items.sub: Check addresses, not names. No cap.
items.alt: Wen in a blue hero suit flies over the city at golden hour, caption: Tell the truth
items.note: Wen says: tell the truth. Check addresses, not names.

items.title: Love life.
items.sub: Good vibes, real data, open heart.
items.alt: Wen with luminous butterfly wings holds a sphere of blue energy above a crowd, caption: Love life
items.note: Wen says: love life. Good vibes, real data, open heart.

items.title: Be kind.
items.sub: Wen came for the smiles. gm.
items.alt: Wen in a white space suit, helmet under his arm, hugged by a laughing girl on an evening square, caption: Be kind
items.note: Wen says: be kind. Wen came for the smiles.
